candidate.title: Kafka 4.0 and newer is using Log4j2 for logging instead of Reload4j/Log4j1
candidate.text: Kafka 4.0 and newer is using Log4j2 for logging instead of Reload4j/Log4j1. If you have any custom logging configuration, you might need to update it during the upgrade to Kafka 4.0.

evidence.locator: L47-L48 (0.46.0 › Major changes, deprecations and removals)
evidence.excerpt:
* Kafka 4.0 and newer is using Log4j2 for logging instead of Reload4j/Log4j1.
  If you have any custom logging configuration, you might need to update it during the upgrade to Kafka 4.0.
